channel.title: Business Insider Nederland - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Nederland (businessinsider.nl)

item.title: Beyoncé is a billionaire. She joins these musicians in the elite club.
item.description: Beyoncé is officially a billionaire, according to Forbes. She joins wealthy musicians like Taylor Swift and Rihanna in the elite club.

item.title: Read the letter celebrity lawyer Alex Spiro wrote to Gavin Newsom, warning that his clients will 'permanently relocate' if California wealth tax passes
item.description: The prominent lawyer, who has represented Elon Musk and Jay Z in the past, said unnamed clients would flee the state if the proposal passes.

item.title: The 5 red flags a Michelin-star pastry chef looks for when visiting a bakery
item.description: Michelin-star chef Camari Mick shared signs that a bakery may not be good, like filled cannoli sitting out and croissants with uneven layers.

item.title: Why OpenAI's $555,000 head of preparedness role may be hard to fill
item.description: The $555,000 a year role requires balancing safety concerns and the demands of a CEO who has shown a penchant for releasing products at a fast clip.

item.title: Trump says he'd still like to fire Jerome Powell
item.description: Trump also said he would be launching a "gross incompetence lawsuit" against the Fed chair.

item.title: China is considering a raft of new controls for training AI on chat log data. Here's what it means.
item.description: China is weighing new controls on AI training, requiring consent before chat logs can be used to improve chatbots and virtual companions.

item.title: $400,000 worth of lobsters bound for Costco locations in the US were stolen in the latest high-profile cargo theft
item.description: Thieves impersonated a legitimate carrier and nabbed the lobster shipment headed for Costco stores in Illinois and Minnesota CEO, Dylan Rexing said.

item.title: DreamWorks CEO turned VC Jeff Katzenberg says that AI is not going to be a 'zero-sum game'
item.description: Bubble or no bubble, AI won't have just one winner, says Jeffrey Katzenberg.

item.title: Companies are slashing middle management. Jamba Juice's former CEO says it is crucial for success.
item.description: He said this management layer drives good company culture, which is crucial for bottom-line growth.

item.title: Passengers on a Ryanair flight to Tenerife were injured when the plane hit turbulence
item.description: A Ryanair flight to Tenerife returned to Birmingham after the plane encountered turbulence. Several passengers were injured.
